en.name: Minstrel
en.ability: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
en.flavor: And I shall hear, tho' soft you tread above me... And all my dreams will warm and sweeter be... If you'll not fail to tell me that you love me... I simply sleep in peace until you come to me.

revisions.v1: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.

zh.name: 吟游诗人
zh.ability: 当一名爪牙死于处决时，除了你和旅行者以外的所有其他玩家醉酒直到明天黄昏。
